wins.label: Transformation progress
wins.evidence: We have made meaningful progress in executing our transformation and simplifying our firm.

wins.label: Dividend increase
wins.evidence: We will increase our dividend from $0.53 to $0.56 per share.

wins.label: Buyback resumption
wins.evidence: We will resume modest buybacks this quarter.

wins.label: Improved risk management
wins.evidence: The tech investments we have made are making a difference. We have reduced the time it takes to book loans, automated controls for our traders to reduce error.

wins.label: Strong business performance
wins.evidence: Our results show the relentless focus we have in executing our strategy as we continue to drive towards our medium-term return targets.

risks.label: Regulatory challenges
risks.evidence: These actions were not entirely unexpected to us, it is no doubt disappointing for our investors and for our people.

risks.label: Data governance issues
risks.evidence: We've been public this year about the fact that we were behind in this particular area and that we had increased our investment as a result.

risks.label: Credit losses
risks.evidence: We have fallen short in data quality management, particularly related to regulatory reporting.

risks.label: Uncertainty around Basel III
risks.evidence: We will continue to assess the level of buybacks on a quarterly basis, particularly given the uncertainty around the Basel III endgame.

risks.label: Economic uncertainty
risks.evidence: In Europe, while rate cuts have begun, the region's lack of competitiveness continues to be a drag on growth.

wins.label: Reduced Risk & Improved Controls
wins.evidence: We've reduced the time it takes to book loans, automated controls for our traders to reduce error, move risk analytics to a cloud-based infrastructure and increase the resiliency of our platforms to reduce downtime.

wins.label: Regulatory Acknowledgement
wins.evidence: It was acknowledged on Wednesday that we have made meaningful progress in executing our transformation and simplifying our firm.

wins.label: Improved Data Governance
wins.evidence: We've stood up a data governance process and streamlined our data architecture to facilitate straight-through processing.

risks.label: Data Quality Issues
risks.evidence: We have fallen short in data quality management, particularly related to regulatory reporting.

risks.label: Regulatory Scrutiny
risks.evidence: The regulators still said we didn't get it done.

risks.label: NII Pressure
risks.evidence: Net interest income was down almost 4% year-over-year.

risks.label: USPB Profitability Concerns
risks.evidence: USPB RoTCE is still single digit.

risks.label: Uncertain Macro Environment
risks.evidence: Macro environment includes uncertainty around elections and global conflicts.
